Given this information, we should verify the contents of the deployment manifest to ensure the credentials are correctly configured there.

If you can provide me with access to the deployment manifest or any relevant parts of it, I can help you check if the production credentials are set up properly.
Do you have access to the deployment manifest that contains these credentials? If so, could you share a snippet or direct me on how to access it?
